Our ambition

Building
what comes next.

Al Massira Paper Mills is building a benchmark recycled paper mill in Kénitra, at the crossroads of advanced engineering and the circular economy.

Our ambition: to produce quality material locally, with a responsible industrial vision — for Morocco, and for Africa.

Every decision, from fibre sourcing to delivery, is measured against the same standard: what we leave behind matters as much as what we produce.

50M+ Sustainable investment Committed to plant, equipment and energy infrastructure.
120K Tons per year Launch capacity, with a planned short-term extension.
100% Recycled fibre Zero virgin pulp — recovered fibre from local collection networks.
Our journey
  1. 2022

    Foundation

    Al Massira Paper Mills is founded. The project is defined and the first partners commit.

  2. 2023

    Site

    Land secured in the Atlantic Free Zone of Kénitra. Engineering plan approved.

  3. 2024

    Construction

    Works begin and benchmark European industrial equipment is ordered.

  4. 2026

    Production

    First lines go live. 120,000 tons a year — Moroccan paper begins again.

Our values
